question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **Star-crossed lovers**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Lovers whose relationship is doomed. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Star-crossed lovers"** refers to a pair of lovers whose relationship is often thwarted by outside forces or destined to end in tragedy. (दुर्भाग्यशाली प्रेमी) • **Example: **Romeo and Juliet are considered classic examples of star-crossed lovers, as their love story ended in tragedy due to family rivalry. • The phrase originates from astrology, where the position of stars was believed to influence a person's fate. "Star-crossed" suggests that the stars are aligned against the lovers. (सितारों से विपरीत प्रभावित) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Lovers facing many challenges** (बहुत सारी चुनौतियों का सामना करने वाले प्रेमी): This suggests couples who face obstacles but does not necessarily imply a doomed relationship. • **Example: **The couple faced many challenges, but their love for each other only grew stronger. • **Option 3: Very successful lovers** (बहुत सफल प्रेमी): This refers to a couple who have a happy and fulfilling relationship, which is contrary to the meaning of "star-crossed lovers." • **Example: **They are very successful lovers who built a wonderful life together. • **Option 4: Happy lovers** (खुश प्रेमी): This refers to lovers who are content and joyful in their relationship, which is opposite to the tragic connotation of "star-crossed lovers." • **Example: **Their story is of two happy lovers who overcame all odds to be together. 41:T9bf, The correct answer is: **Frequent**.
